gloss: playing with fire; a risky fling

definitions.explanation: Children playing with matches, lighters or fire, a common cause of house fires and a standard warning in fire-prevention campaigns.

definitions.gloss: a risky fling; a dangerous affair
definitions.explanation: A casual love affair, especially an extramarital one, entered into lightly; or more broadly any reckless venture likely to end badly.

notes:
⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧ (fire) + ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧ (play). Sense 2 is the figurative use, like English "playing with fire".

- ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火遊|ひあそ}び: a passing fling
